CONCURRENT DISPLACEMENT
An investigation was made to determine the displacement activities of other agencies for any and all causes. The following data relates to these findings:
Current Projects - South 27th Street
Residential displacement has been reduced to just 3 families remaining on the project, each of which has been assisted successfully but awaiting construction completion of replacement housing and/or occupancy of existing dwellings.
- West Forest Home Avenue
All residential displacees have been relocated successfully; however, 4 commercial establishments remain on this project.
